notes.title: The Crown of Wu 30% discount for Spring Sales!
The Crown of Wu soundtrack!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317018/c73842a2bb65a1d22c00753f5aa4acf29546c052.png[/img]
[h1]The "Making Of" of the Crown of Wu soundtrack is now available![/h1]

If you're one of those people who can't understand a good game without a good soundtrack, you have another reason not to pass up [i]The Crown of Wu[/i]. And now, good fortune is on your side: you can now watch this piece of [b]making of[/b] in which Álex Elósegui and Sergio Villa, members of [b][i]Wild Cat Records[/i][/b], explain in detail [b]how the soundtrack of [i]The Crown of Wu[/i] was composed and produced[/b]

[previewyoutube=-VVl2t5LeNQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]The Crown of Wu's[/b] score seeks to highlight the darkness that follows the main character of the game, Wu. In this way we have a [b]mix of oriental tradition and urban sound[/b] that evolves with the character's arc and his [b]tenebrous intimate psychology[/b]. 

The experience of [b][i]Wild Cat Records[/i][/b] in the film industry was a source of good ideas that they presented to the development studio. They achieved a score with a [b]narrative value[/b] that flows with the story. The [b]traditional Chinese instruments[/b], chosen by the producers, blend perfectly with the more technological elements of the world proposed by The Crown of Wu, where oriental legends merge with science fiction. And, above all,[b] masterfully reinforce the mood of the game[/b], so that you, gamer, can immerse yourself in this universe in an absolute way. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317018/a3827282790a1ec22049a88aa725980e6ffb1ca7.jpg[/img]

But why do we keep telling you about it when you can watch it in the [b]documentary[/b]? More than twenty minutes of pure delight, where musicians and developers shake hands. Especially recommended for those who are interested in the [b]videogame as a sum of arts[/b]. 

Believe us. When you see this making off you will understand why you feel like a tank aiming at a bell tower when you play The Crown of Wu. It's the power of music, comrade. 

Remember, The Crown of Wu is now available on [url=https://store.playstation.com/es-es/concept/235159]PS4[/url], [url=https://store.playstation.com/es-es/concept/235159]PS5[/url] and for PC via [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1732220/The_Crown_of_Wu/]Steam[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1732220/The_Crown_of_Wu/

notes.title: The Crown of Wu Major Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317018/c73842a2bb65a1d22c00753f5aa4acf29546c052.png[/img]
[h1]The Crown of Wu Major Update[/h1]

Attention fans of the monkey king! The adventure inspired by the Chinese legend of Wukong has a new update with all these new features:

[h3][b]Major Bug Fix[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where you couldn't complete level 5 in a second run.
[*] Fixed an issue that made it impossible to activate the Pagoda if you die after opening the first chest and before opening the big gates.
[*] Solved the problem where the trophies were not activated in Steam. Now the lost trophies will be updated automatically when starting the game.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented Wukong's animations from loading when healing during a teleport.
[*] Fixed an issue where Wukong's animations were stuck after QTE when you enter them with an attack animation.
[*] Fixed an issue where Wukong could get stuck in the moving pedestals
[*] Fixed an issue where some enemies were not suffering from the lightning power effect

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317018/d40c5262ddc9839e8f51bfaf82af6ad5ed8dbd97.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h3][b]Minor Bug Fix[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The music in the last video is no longer coupled with the credits.
[*] Zhu's fire tornado no longer affects Wukong once Zhu is defeated.
[*] Level 6 mages no longer teleport out of the combat area
[*] Added mana recharge crystals in zones where they were required
[*] Fixed multiple incorrect collisions
[*] Fixed areas where it was possible to exit the map
[*] Fixed the triggers of several help messages

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317018/54ca06f6abc4e6bb340d68b8acd3f4956428365e.gif[/img]
[/list]
The game puts us in the role of Wu in an adventure and a world inspired by Journey to the West, the traditional Chinese tale starring the Monkey King, where we will have to go from anti-hero to hero trying to regain the crown and take down Zhu.

Remember that The Crown of Wu is already available on PS4, PS5 and Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1732220/The_Crown_of_Wu/

notes.title: The Crown of Wu is available NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317018/66d268a7f767b8ace94515d933f002d339b716b1.gif[/img]

[h1]¡The Crown of Wu is available NOW![/h1]

Finally, the boarding gates open to that game we've been telling you about for months. We are launching The Crown of Wu, the highly anticipated action-adventure title is now available on [url=https://store.playstation.com/es-es/concept/235159]PS4[/url], [url=https://store.playstation.com/es-es/concept/235159]PS5[/url] and for PC via [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1732220/The_Crown_of_Wu/]Steam[/url].

In addition, as we had announced, [i]Meridiem Games[/i] has created the [b]physical edition[/b] "[url=https://meridiem-games.com/en/game/bDKbAVa17WY]Legend Edition[/url]" for PS5, with an [b]exclusive design case[/b], a [b]set of postcards[/b], and a [b]letter addressed to the player[/b]. You can already find it in your favorite physical points of sale, because the best trips are worth keeping a souvenir. 

[previewyoutube=H4avQOztsA8;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[h3][b]Wu's crown must be found![/b][/h3]
Explore a new world inspired by [b]Journey to the West[/b], a traditional Chinese tale about the [b]Monkey King, Sun Wukong[/b]. Discover a future-past fantasy world as Sun Wukong, fighting alone against enemies and overcoming complex obstacles to recover the great Crown stolen by Zhu. With Zhu waiting to fight and kill you, will you be able to retrieve the Crown and save your world from destruction?

[b]Featured content:[/b]
[list]
[*] A virtuoso update of [b]Chinese mythology[/b], transported to a science fiction world.
[*] A [b]protagonist full of charisma[/b] who can master four different powers.
[*] [b]Intuitive and fresh combat modes[/b] that promise hours of fun.
[*] [b]Action, exploration, puzzles and parkour[/b] in a perfectly balanced ratio.
[*] A [b]unforgettable soundtrack[/b], composed by Wild Cat Records.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1732220/The_Crown_of_Wu/

notes.title: The Crown of Wu Releases March 24!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317018/c73842a2bb65a1d22c00753f5aa4acf29546c052.png[/img]

[h1]The Crown of Wu sets a date for your journey to the legendary East[/h1]

If you're not excited about [i]The Crown of Wu[/i] we have news that will for sure... The [b]release date[/b]! 
We are in love with this amazing story set in legendary China, developed by [i]Red Mountain[/i] in collaboration with the [i]Trazos[/i] school, and that you will have the next [b]March 24[/b] in [b]physical[/b] and [b]digital[/b] stores[/b] by the hand of [i]Meridiem Games[/i] and [i]PlayStation Talents[/i].

[previewyoutube=yPSuld1qHW4;full][/previewyoutube]

It's not only that [i]The Crown of Wu[/i] will be released in digital edition for [b]PC, PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5[/b]. In addition, [i]Meridiem Games[/i] has created a special physical edition, "Legend Edition", which will be distributed in stores with an exclusive design sleeve, a set of postcards, and a letter addressed to the player, in which Wu himself, asks for help to regain his crown.

In [i]The Crown of The Wu[/i] the player must recover Wu's lost crown to save the world that condemned him to prison for centuries. But first he will have to control his powers: fire, air, earth and lightning. In this story you will confront multiple enemies, through a simple and intuitive combat system. You will also have to explore its spectacular sceneries and use all your cleverness and skill to go through them.

Go practice eating with chopsticks because we're going to China, buddy!
Featured content:
[list]
[*] A brilliant update of [b]Chinese mythology[/b], transported to a science fiction world. 
[*] A [b]charismatic character[/b] who can master four different powers.
[*] Intuitive and fresh [b]combat[/b] modes that promise hours of fun. 
[*] [b]Action, exploration, puzzles and parkour[/b] in a perfectly balanced proportion. 
[*] A [b]soundtrack[/b] that you won't forget, composed by [i]Wild Cat Records[/i].
[/list]
[url=https://store.playstation.com/es-es/concept/235159]PlayStation[/url]

[*] Added blocking ability
[*] Improved feedback on hits and blocks during combat.
[*] Fixes in the buffer of the attacks that improve the feeling when doing the pierce attack
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the focus to change during combat
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the sprint to be reactivated when it shouldn't be
[*] Fixed a bug where the camera shake during the sprint remained perpetual
